1.title: Bookmark feature
1.text: Rapid Recap's new Bookmark feature lets you save, manage, and quickly access your favorite articles. Personalize your feed and track your reading progress easily. Stay informed effortlessly!

2.title: Wise Web
2.text: Wise Web is a dynamic feature that lets you connect, share, and grow with others in a vibrant digital community. It's where knowledge flows and collective wisdom thrives, weaving a network of meaningful connections.
